TEJAX KART / PLAYER HANDBOOK

Built for
one more lap.

TEJAX KART: Apex Protocol is a free 3D arcade racing game for web browsers. It combines circuit racing with optional vehicle combat, local career scores and customizable cars.

Game facts

NameTEJAX KART: Apex Protocol
Edition6.2 · updated 23 October 2026
PriceFree; all cars and paint colors unlocked
PlatformsDesktop browsers on Windows, macOS and Linux; mobile web app on Android and iOS
VehiclesScout, Titan, Assassin, Vector, Apex and Rally
CircuitsNeo City, Crimson Canyon and Glacier Ridge
Solo modesRace, Combat, Elimination, Survival and Time trial
Multiplayer2–6 drivers using a separately hosted LAN server
InputsKeyboard, mouse, touch and optional phone tilt
RenderingThree.js / WebGL with selectable graphics quality

What changed in 6.2?

Rebuilt Crimson Canyon scenery to keep rocks clear of the track, improved lighting and road contrast, added automatic target detection and predictive blaster aim, and expanded the circuit to eight distinct power-ups. Mobile tilt steering and browser installation remain supported.

Open source and credits

The project source is distributed under the MIT license. Three.js and the optional ws server dependency retain their own MIT notices. The repository includes its license and third-party notices. The cars and track geometry are generated in code.

Designed for choice

Adjust graphics quality, difficulty, weather, volume, camera motion and driving keys. Progress stays in your browser. There is no account requirement, paid car unlock, or cloud leaderboard.

Updated 23 October 2026 · Edition 6.2
